Max Glonek

Trimester 1, 2025

1 Get data and basic cleaning

1.1 Read in data

data(credit_data, package = "modeldata")

1.2 Convert to tibble

credit_data <- as_tibble(credit_data)
credit_data

1.3 Clean names

credit_data <- credit_data %>%
  clean_names()
credit_data

3 Pre-processing

Consists of three steps: - recipe - prep - bake / juice

3.1 Recipe

3.1.1 Set up types of variables

credit_recipe <- recipe(status ~ ., data = credit_data)
credit_recipe
## 
## ── Recipe ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
## 
## ── Inputs
## Number of variables by role
## outcome:    1
## predictor: 13
summary(credit_recipe)

3.1.2 Add steps

3.1.2.1 Center and scale

credit_recipe <- 
  credit_recipe %>% 
  step_center(all_numeric()) %>% 
  step_scale(all_numeric())
credit_recipe
## 
## ── Recipe ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
## 
## ── Inputs
## Number of variables by role
## outcome:    1
## predictor: 13
## 
## ── Operations
## • Centering for: all_numeric()
## • Scaling for: all_numeric()

3.1.2.2 Skewness

get_skewness <- function(x){
  # Remove missing
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  # Get mean
  x_bar <- mean(x)
  # Get number of observations
  n <- length(x)
  # Calculate v
  v <- sum( (x - x_bar)^2 ) / (n - 1)
  # Calculate skewness
  skewness <- sum( (x - x_bar)^3 ) / ((n - 1) * v^(3/2))
  return(skewness)
}
get_skewness(rnorm(100))
## [1] 0.449358
get_skewness(rexp(100))
## [1] 1.538785
credit_data %>%
  summarise(
    across(where(is.numeric), get_skewness)
  )
